slides.eyebrow: The problem isn't you. It's too many menus.
slides.sub: Two are on Main St. One bakes in ovens imported from Italy. Swipe for all 3.

slides.title: Antonio's Brick Oven Pizza
slides.body: A brick oven pizzeria on Main St. It sells pizza by the slice for pickup, plus delivery.

slides.title: L&L Pizza & Pasta
slides.body: A New York style pizza shop on Main St, with homemade pasta and Italian dishes too.

slides.title: Wood Stack Pizza + Kitchen
slides.body: A sit-down pizza and Italian kitchen. Its pizzas cook at 900 degrees in ovens imported from Italy.

slides.title: Your Metuchen pizza map
slides.tip: Touring near the train? Metuchen station is on Main St too, on NJ Transit's Northeast Corridor Line.
